newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - Oct 4.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - Oct 4.

text.p: * Scotts Co said it expects to post $17.6 million in charges for the fiscal year and expects to break even before accounting for the charges. Shares closed at 20.
* KinderCare Learning Centers Inc said it agreed to be acquired by Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co. Shares closed at 16-1/4.
* CEM Corp said it expects first quarter revenues and earnings to be below those of a year ago. Shares closed at 11-1/8.
* Emeritus Corp said it expects third quarter earnings to be "well below" expectations. Shares closed at 15-1/2.
* Fidelity National Corp said it expects to report a loss for the third quarter because of losses at its credit card business. Shares closed at 10-5/8.
* Shaw Industries Inc said it expects third quarter earnings to be below analysts' estimates. Shares closed at 11-7/8.
* Planet Hollywood International Inc said it was comfortable with 1997 and 1998 earnings estimates. Shares closed at 27.
